title: Multimodal Representation Engineering for Robust AI Alignment

contributions.purpose: 提出跨模态表征识别与映射框架(MRepE)
contributions.mechanism: 因果中介分析+表征相似度识别概念原型,对比学习跨模态对齐函数
contributions.evaluation: 表征识别 CLIP/BLIP-2/GPT-4V + MRepE 0.83/0.85/0.86 vs 基线 0.60/0.63/0.64
contributions.source_quote: a novel framework for identifying and mapping cross-modal representations in large multimodal models

contributions.mechanism: 直接概念方向向量加法 + 注意力掩码干预
contributions.evaluation: 组合干预成功率 CLIP 91.5/BLIP-2 93.2/GPT-4V 94.8% vs 基线 45-52%
contributions.source_quote: innovative methods for intervening and modifying these representations to achieve desired behavioral outcomes

contributions.purpose: 提出多模态安全评测指标
contributions.mechanism: CMC/VAS/SCR/AR 等指标 + 自建 1,500 样本 Cross-Modal Safety Dataset
contributions.source_quote: comprehensive evaluation metrics specifically designed for assessing multimodal alignment and safety

contributions.purpose: 分析 RepE 技术跨架构可迁移性
contributions.source_quote: empirical analysis of the transferability of representation engineering techniques across different multimodal architectures

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our approach builds upon the foundation of traditional RepE while incorporating novel techniques for cross-modal representation alignment

notes: 4 条自声明贡献。强数据红旗——疑似结果编造:(1)摘要用提案式语气(“This research proposes to extend”“The study aims to develop”)却又给出“Our experimental results demonstrate”全套实验;(2)技术上不可行——声称对 GPT-4V 做内部表征识别/激活干预,但 GPT-4V 为闭源 API,无法访问或编辑内部表征,该结果不可能真实;(3)表格数字高度模板化——所有提升集中 +23%~+40%、± 极小、一律 p<0.001,无失败/负例;(4)无种子/无逐数据集明细,方法全为通用公式。属典型 AI 幻觉式伪实验,desk-reject 级。
